verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents delivery of raw events to ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3 and GCS, either streamed or micro-batched, with automatic table and column creation. Profile Builder writes customer profile records into your warehouse, and a community user reports hands-on success loading events into BigQuery. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-configurable batch schedules or frequency (only 'optional batching' and destination-dependent micro-batching are described), and independent corroboration of profile delivery and lake (S3) delivery.
